in_marathi.name: Harshashree
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity, wisdom, and strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harshashree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harshashree is the name of a Hindu goddess, a combination of Harsh (rough) and Ashree (prosperous). She is a symbol of strength and wisdom, who overcomes challenges and brings prosperity. Harshashree is also known as Shree or Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity in Hinduism. She is often depicted with four arms, holding a lotus in two hands and a bell and a conch shell in the other two. Harshashree is also associated with Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and learning. She is often invoked during religious ceremonies and rituals to seek her blessings for wisdom and prosperity.
